node.title: N=256 E=34 progression-weld reduction
node.statement: Every residual N=256, folded-(3,4,0), V=68 progression template has one of 62 normal forms H={0,t,2t}, t!=32. Its outer heavy coefficients are opposite and a light occupies one of four exact singleton-weld positions. Odd cyclotomic automorphisms collapse the 2,372,794,560-vector chamber to five invariant representatives and 191,354,400 census vectors.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: equal outer signs are impossible because the repeated class has only two heavy-light extensions; unit automorphisms reduce the complete invariant census to five forms. The progression template remains open.
